# 2 Baruch Chapter 86 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**86:1** "And-now-I-command-you that-when-you-have-received-this-letter, you-read-it-in-your-assemblies with-care."

**86:2** "And-meditate-upon-it, above-all on-the-days-of-your-fasts; and-remember-me through-it, even-as-I-remember-you through-it."

**86:3** "And-fare-you-well, always-and-in-good-health; and-forget-not-the-LORD our-God."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
